messages:
incident-bot: Pager — HIGH: generation-service p99 latency above 5s for last 5m in us-west. Pager rule: latency>3s. Link: https://warroom.redwood/INC-1799502467

alex: i'm on-call, got the page. joining war room now. pinging on-call backup @jordan

jordan: here. i'll take ownership. war room link looks good. first pass: suspected model backend saturation. grabbing traces & p99s.

alex: confirmation — paging confirmed. i ran quick query:
```
# grafana api
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/v1/query?query=histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=\\\"generation-service\\\"}[5m])) by (le))"
```
returns ~5.6s for p99 on us-west. error rate unchanged. no obvious 5xx spike.

jordan: logs show a lot of `KVCache miss` entries and retries to model-variant v2q. sample:
```
2026-03-10T14:04:12Z generation-service [warn] KVCache miss for key=abcd1234 model=v2q
2026-03-10T14:04:13Z generation-service [info] fallback to model=v1.8
```

samir: i can try scaling the generation deployment by +2 replicas in us-west. want me to do that now? :rocket:

jordan: yes, please scale and also put a temporary route rule to prefer model=v1.8 for requests with seq_len>1024. if we still see latency, fallback to v1.8 for all requests.

ops-sre: scaling underway. kubectl scale deployment generation-service -n prod --replicas=8
ops-sre: scaled. monitoring p99 now.

emily: drafting status page and customer note. Proposed status page update draft:

```
We are investigating elevated latency for text generation in the US-West region. Some requests are experiencing higher response times; we are mitigating and will provide updates every 15 minutes.
```

alex: good. customer-facing draft for notifications channel (support to send):

```
Subject: Temporary latency increase affecting generation API in US-West

Hi — we’re investigating a temporary increase in response times for the generation API in US-West. Some requests may take longer than usual. We are actively mitigating; expected degradation window: 15-30 mins. We will follow up when resolved.

If you are experiencing critical impact please reply and we'll prioritize your tenant.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Engineering
```

jordan: adding runbook steps: 1) scale replicas (done), 2) apply model route tweak, 3) enable KVCache warmup for hot prefixes, 4) if unresolved, rollback recent quantized model rollout.

samir: applied route tweak to prefer v1.8 for long seqs. command:
```
redwoodctl route apply --service generation-service --region us-west --policy "prefer=\\\"v1.8\\\" seq_len>1024"
```

ops-sre: p99 dropped from 5.6s -> 2.1s after scale+route. error rates steady. continuing to watch.

emily: posted status page update (internal): https://status.redwood/incident/1799502467 — will push public update once we confirm stability for 5m.

alex: documenting ownership: owner=jordan, deputy=alex, support point=emily, infra=ops-sre, runtime lead=samir. war room: https://warroom.redwood/INC-1799502467

jordan: next actions: monitor for 10m. if stable, we'll close with a follow-up postmortem. if p99 creep returns, we'll rollback v2q rollout and open a formal RCA.

alex: confirmed paging working, handoff plan if needed: @alex -> @jordan -> @oncall-night. I'll remain reachable for 30m then hand off.

ops-sre: monitoring graph: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz/generation-p99?orgId=1&from=now-30m

emily: timeline note for post-incident comms: start time: 2026-03-10T14:03:00Z (pager), mitigation window: 14:05-14:20 (scale+route), provisional resolved at 14:15 pending 10m stability check.

jordan: thanks team. keeping thread updated. will post final status and assign postmortem owner after closure.

incident-bot: Incident updated — severity: P2 -> monitoring. last update at 2026-03-10T14:18:54Z
